apoapsis.guide.cmd.book: The Custodian slips a guide into your pack.
apoapsis.guide.book.title: Custodian Guide
apoapsis.guide.book.author: The Custodian
apoapsis.guide.parts.title: Parts
apoapsis.guide.parts.1: Ages open as you reach firsts: First Flight brings Age 4, a Pale sample brings Age 5. Your advancements list them.
apoapsis.guide.parts.2: Your recipe book has the Age 3 ship parts: iron, copper, glass, redstone and gold, and a blast furnace or fire charge for each engine.
apoapsis.guide.build.title: Build
apoapsis.guide.build.1: Join the parts face to face: the cockpit, a gyroscope so it can turn, a tank, and a Spark thruster placed while you look down, so its exhaust points down.
apoapsis.guide.build.2: Fill the tank with Hydrolox Canisters (a water bucket and three iron nuggets each), then right-click the cockpit with an empty hand to board.
apoapsis.guide.launch.title: Launch
apoapsis.guide.launch.1: %1$s raises the throttle, %2$s opens it fully, %3$s cuts it. %4$s and %5$s pitch, %6$s and %7$s yaw, %8$s and %9$s roll. %10$s cycles SAS.
apoapsis.guide.launch.2: Climb above 1,500 m, then land in one piece: that is First Flight. Past 2 km the ship leaves the air for orbit.
apoapsis.guide.ascent.title: Age 4
apoapsis.guide.ascent.1: Age 4 opens Landing Legs (iron, a piston, an iron block) and Parachute Packs (white wool, string, leather).
apoapsis.guide.ascent.2: The Fuel Refinery (iron, copper, a blast furnace, a cauldron) takes water and furnace fuel and fills the tanks beside it.
apoapsis.guide.orbit.title: Orbit
apoapsis.guide.orbit.1: You have left the air, but this arc still ends in the ground. Burn prograde at the top of it (%1$s cycles SAS to prograde) until PE reads above 12 km.
apoapsis.guide.orbit.2: Cut the throttle with %2$s once PE clears 12 km: a coasting orbit above the air counts as a Stable Orbit.
apoapsis.guide.map.title: Map and burn
apoapsis.guide.map.1: %1$s opens the system map. Click your orbit line to place a maneuver node and drag its prograde handle until the brass path marks a Pale encounter. Its card gives the Δv and when to ignite.
apoapsis.guide.map.2: %2$s and %3$s change time warp (engines off, singleplayer). Warp to ignition and burn prograde until your own path marks the encounter. Tab flips to the flat map and its window countdown.
apoapsis.guide.pale.title: Landing
apoapsis.guide.pale.1: Pale has no air and about a sixth of Verdance's gravity, so only your engine can slow you. Cycle SAS to retrograde with %1$s and burn against your motion.
apoapsis.guide.pale.2: Land on three or more Landing Legs at the bottom of the ship: they let it take about 24 m/s of vertical speed instead of 12.
apoapsis.guide.sample.title: Sample
apoapsis.guide.sample.1: Land, stop and level the ship, then %1$s turns it back into blocks. Break Pale's regolith or basalt: about one block in six drops a sample, once a minute at most.
apoapsis.guide.sample.2: Keep enough hydrolox for the way home, then right-click the cockpit to rebuild the ship and climb to orbit. The map (%2$s) shows where your path leads.
apoapsis.guide.home.title: Home
apoapsis.guide.home.1: Verdance again. Bring your periapsis down into the air (below 12 km) and use SAS retrograde (%1$s) to shed speed; the air slows you further.
apoapsis.guide.home.2: Below 2 km the ship comes down to the surface. With Parachute Packs aboard, %2$s opens them under 250 m/s; faster tears them off.
apoapsis.guide.done.title: Loop closed
apoapsis.guide.done.1: That is the loop: a ship you built, an orbit, Pale, a sample, home.
apoapsis.guide.done.2: Nothing in this prototype needs Age 5 yet, and the charts beyond Pale are still blank.
